evidence.name: commit
evidence.source: function commit(op,payload){try{if(storageError)throw Error(storageError);if(!writeAllowed())throw Error('조회 권한으로 접속했습니다. 저장 권한이 필요합니다.');const next=C.command(db,op,payload,policy());localStorage.setItem(storageKey,JSON.stringify(next.db));db=next.db;dirty=false;if(activeEditorModal?.host===host)activeEditorModal.updated=true;ctx.toast('로컬 자료에 저장했습니다.');return next.result||true;}catch(e){lastCommitError=e.message;ctx.toast(e.message);return false;}}

readonlyEditor
evidence.source: function readonlyEditor(){if(writeAllowed())return;host.prepend(note('조회 전용입니다. 입력 내용과 양식을 확인할 수 있으며 저장할 수 없습니다.'));for(const x of host.querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea'))if(!x.closest('.entry-row-find'))x.disabled=true;for(const b of host.querySelectorAll('button'))if(!['닫기','리스트','인쇄 미리보기','Option ▾','찾기(F3)','찾기','찾기 닫기','최신 전표 다시 읽기'].includes(b.textContent))b.disabled=true;}

evidence.name: documentDialog
evidence.source: function documentDialog(type,existing,refresh){const key=route.id+'::detail:'+type+':'+(existing?.id||'new'),modalRoute={...route,id:key};return editorDialog(C.types[type]+(existing?' 상세 / 수정':' 신규'),key,()=>{route=modalRoute;docEditor(type,existing,undefined,drafts.get(key));},refresh||refreshCurrentView);}

evidence.name: save
evidence.source: save=()=>{try{const rec=values();F.check(configuration.meta.fields,configuration.read());if(commit('master',{key,record:rec,originalCode:record?.code})){discardDraft(draftKey);activeEditorModal.dialog.close();}}catch(e){ctx.toast(e.message);}}

evidence.name: legacyAllocations
evidence.source: legacyAllocations=!!existing&&!existing.lines.some(l=>l.lineId)&&db.documents.some(d=>d.sourceId===existing.id||d.lines.some(l=>(l.planAllocations||[]).some(a=>a.documentId===existing.id&&!a.sourceLineId)))

evidence.name: identifyLines
evidence.source: identifyLines=()=>{if((!lineSuppliers&&!lines.some(line=>line.lineId))||legacyAllocations)return;const used=new Set(lines.map(l=>l.lineId).filter(Boolean));for(const l of lines)if(!l.lineId){let id;do{id='L'+(++lineSerial);}while(used.has(id));l.lineId=id;used.add(id);}}

evidence.name: readLines
evidence.source: readLines=()=>controls.map(c=>({...c.originalLine,item:c.item.value,qty:c.qty.value,price:c.price.value,discount:c.discount.value,memo:c.memo.value,...(lineSuppliers?{supplier:c.supplier.value}:{}),custom:{...c.originalCustom,...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(c.customControls||{}).map(([k,x])=>[k,controlValue(x)]))}}))

evidence.name: getDoc
evidence.source: getDoc=(raw=false)=>{const value=({...initial,...extraHeader,...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(fields).map(([k,x])=>[k,controlValue(x)])),custom:raw?configuration.rawCustomValues():configuration.customValues(),type,id:existing?.id,sourceId,lines:raw?readLines():readLines().filter(l=>l.item)});if(purchasing&&C.listed(initial)){value.status=value.confirmation==='미확인'?'미확인':value.progress;}return value;}

evidence.name: save
evidence.source: save=(print=false,{retain=false}={})=>{try{if(existing&&retainSupported&&JSON.stringify(db.documents.find(doc=>doc.id===existing.id))!==baseSnapshot)throw Error('다른 화면에서 전표가 변경됐습니다. 현재 수정 초안을 확인하고 최신 전표 다시 읽기를 선택하세요.');F.check(configuration.meta.fields,configuration.read());const result=commit('document',getDoc());if(result){discardDraft(route.id);capture=null;if(retain){const scope=activeEditorModal?.host===host?activeEditorModal:null;if(scope){scope.key=scope.baseRoute.id+'::detail:'+type+':'+result.id;route={...route,id:scope.key};}docEditor(type,result);dirty=false;if(scope){scope.baseline=JSON.stringify(editor?.read?.());const title=C.types[type]+' 상세 / 수정';scope.dialog.setAttribute('aria-label',title);scope.dialog.querySelector('.inv-modal-head h2').textContent=title;}return;}if(activeEditorModal?.host===host){activeEditorModal.dialog.close();if(print)printDoc(result);}else if(print){if(retainSupported)docEditor(type,result);printDoc(result);}else {docList({name:C.types[type]+'조회',docType:type,kind:'list'});}}else error.textContent='저장하지 못했습니다. 하단 알림과 입력 내용을 확인하세요.';}catch(e){error.textContent=e.message;ctx.toast(e.message);}}

evidence.name: syncSourceLocks
evidence.source: syncSourceLocks=()=>{const generated=(extraHeader.generatedFrom||initial.generatedFrom)==='purchase-plan',linked=Boolean(sourceId||generated);outer.querySelector('[data-source-note]')?.remove();if(linked){const info=note(generated?'발주계획으로 생성한 품목과 수량은 원본 배분을 보존합니다. 수량은 원계획 수정 후 발주서를 취소하고 다시 생성하세요. 단가·할인·적요는 수정할 수 있습니다.':'원본에 연결된 품목은 변경할 수 없습니다. 처리할 수량과 단가·적요를 입력하세요.');const linkedIds=[...new Set([sourceId,...lines.flatMap(l=>(l.planAllocations||l.importedFrom||[]).map(a=>a.documentId))].filter(Boolean))];if(linkedIds.length)info.append(N('span',' 연결 원본: '+linkedIds.join(', ')));info.dataset.sourceNote='';outer.append(info);}for(const b of form.querySelectorAll('button'))if(['행 추가','선택 행 복사','품목 추가','My품목','바코드','재고 품목 선택','안전재고','소요','전표 바코드'].includes(b.textContent))b.disabled=linked||!writeAllowed();}

evidence.name: applyDraft
evidence.source: applyDraft=next=>{if(!writeAllowed())return false;const {lines:nextLines,...nextHeader}=next;extraHeader=nextHeader;for(const [key,x]of Object.entries(fields))if(Object.hasOwn(next,key)){if(x.type==='checkbox')x.checked=Boolean(next[key]);else x.value=next[key]??'';}if(purchasing){const state=C.purchasingState(next);fields.confirmation.value=state.confirmation;fields.progress.value=state.progress;}sourceId=next.sourceId;lines=next.lines.length?next.lines:[{qty:1,price:0}];renderLines();syncSourceLocks();dirty=true;capture?.();}

evidence.source: function purchasingState(d){return {confirmation:d.confirmation??(d.status==='미확인'?'미확인':'확인'),progress:d.progress??(d.status==='완료'?'완료':'진행')};}

evidence.name: purchasingLineState
evidence.source: function purchasingLineState(d,line){return {...purchasingState(d),progress:line.progress??purchasingState(d).progress};}

evidence.name: validateLineProgress
evidence.source: function validateLineProgress(d,line){if(line.progress!==undefined&&(d.type!=='plan'||!['진행','완료'].includes(line.progress)))throw Error('품목행 진행상태를 확인하세요.');}

evidence.source: function allocations(doc,line){if(doc.type==='purchaseorder'&&doc.generatedFrom==='purchase-plan')return line.planAllocations||[];return doc.sourceId?[{documentId:doc.sourceId,item:line.item,qty:line.qty,sourceLineId:line.sourceLineId||''}]:[];}

evidence.name: ownLineIds
evidence.source: function ownLineIds(d){return d.lines.every(l=>typeof l.lineId==='string'&&l.lineId.length>0&&l.lineId.length<=200)&&new Set(d.lines.map(l=>l.lineId)).size===d.lines.length;}

evidence.name: structuredLines
evidence.source: function structuredLines(db,d){return d.type==='purchaseorder'&&d.generatedFrom==='purchase-plan'||ownLineIds(d)||!!(d.sourceId&&db.documents.find(x=>x.id===d.sourceId)?.lines.some(l=>l.lineId));}
